purpose: Weight round on the leave-one-month-out development rows (tools/run_lomo_rows.py -> runs/lomo_dev/rows.parquet): January and July 2025 with every component on eleven-month footing (like the ranking's twelve-month refits), plus December from the fair set (January-November refits on both sides). The three months are the equal-footing months; November (forward fold side on nine months against an eleven-month v9 side) is reported, not used. No model is fitted.

prior_context.note: Declared BEFORE any LOMO component, row or score exists (LOMO v9, residual refits, tree leaves and GPU networks are still running). The fair-set readings are known: December favoured unmatched weight 0.8 (fair_weights_v1), LIRF v9 shares toward 0 (fair_lirf_v1, v34), u300 and cs50 (disagreement_gate_v1, callsign_fix_v1).
prior_context.hypothesis: whether the fair set's January/July preference for the v9 side on unmatched rows was the fold side's seven-month training (data quantity) or season

rows: runs/lomo_dev/rows.parquet (SHA-256 in docs/lomo_dev/rows_summary.json); months 2025-01 and 2025-07 with provenance 'lomo', 2025-12 'fair'

control.name: v34
control.reproduction: on the fair months, build() at the control must equal the v34 rebuild of tools/run_disagreement_gate.py; on every month the mix column must equal mixed(committee, nets, 0.75) to 1e-9

candidate_semantics: outer / lirf_v9 as configs/fair_weights_v1.json (LIRF net:tree proportions kept); network_share a: mix = (1 - a) committee + a nets where both are finite, else the committee (tools/run_adsb_nn_dev.mixed); gate u300 as configs/disagreement_gate_v1.json on the candidate's own base / mix; callsign w as configs/callsign_fix_v1.json (offsets from the non-recipe months, applied last); floor per row
selection: Unchanged rule over the three recipe months: eligible when no recipe month is worse on ALL rows, the mean ratio is at least 0.02% below 1, and every touched month's paired-day 95% interval lies below zero; lowest mean ratio among eligible; otherwise keep the control. Combinations of eligible single changes need their own declaration.
ship: delta from the dry-run detail (candidate minus v34's recipe) added to the incumbent's floats; independent rebuild; audit; upload only on the user's decision.
